TITLE: Maintenance Log: Streetlamp #41
TEXT:
MAINTENANCE LOG — STREETLAMP #41

Date: 11/02
Issue: flicker / intermittent hum / attracts moths with ambition
Action: replaced bulb; lamp continued to blink as if speaking

Date: 11/09
Issue: lamp illuminating only what is regretted
Action: adjusted angle; regrets relocated 3 feet east

Date: 11/16
Issue: lamp refuses to turn off at dawn
Action: spoke gently; promised it rest; it dimmed to a sigh

Technician note:
This lamp is not broken.
It is attentive.
If you stand under it long enough,
you will remember a name you thought you lost.
